_comment: The end-of-game score screen (work order 403, open fix 120). Its title is ARTWORK in the original (SCORE.LBX's picture), so the word is typed here per decision 15; every other word is the engine's own, from the block SCOR. A mod replaces this file.

marks.deviation_hud_table: The tally in a HUD panel on the universal background, where the original draws SCORE.LBX's picture and its cursor (score.cpp:86-120).
marks.hd_extension_score_header: The player the tally is for, above the lines; the original prints no name.
marks.transcription_score_title: The title word HALL OF FAME: the original's score screen carries it in its picture, read off the native frame of the live run (work order 405); the German word is the Hall of Fame screen's (RUHMESHALLE).
marks.omission_score_pop_pictures: The rows of people (Draw_Pop, score.cpp:1282-1345; Draw_Eliminated_Race_Pictures, :725-790) are drawn by popicons.py from the colonies and defeated players the snapshot holds: the rule is the original's (score_pop_rule, score_pop_count, score_captured_rule, score_portrait_boxes), the random picks are HD's even spread (DEVIATION score_pop_pick), the captured portraits' races UNVERIFIED (score_captured_races), the portrait frame DEVIATION (score_portrait_frame); a row whose pictures are not extracted is omitted (OMISSION).
